notes.title: Notice of Addition of Chinese (Simplified) Version
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40901157/a0c49152a052b08805e5a79ae7171f48d5b19445.png
"All Dream Long A Flower Storm" is now also available in simplified Chinese.If you have already downloaded the game, you can play it as is after the update.

Relax into a dreamscape alongside a friendly, hungry demon called Baku. 
Explore a world made of fairytales, traditional Japanese legends, classic Western literature, and peculiar scenery where real-life physics doesn't apply. 
Solve riddles and puzzles to help colorful characters, some human, some not.
